meta.title: Sharp Barber Bangkok | Haircuts, Fades & Hot Towel Shaves
meta.description: Barbershop on Sukhumvit Soi 11, Bangkok. Precision haircuts, skin fades, beard trims and straight razor shaves. Book online in a minute. Demo project.

common.messageOnLine: Message us on LINE (opens in a new tab)

shop.name: Sharp Barber Bangkok
shop.slogan: Clean fades. Hot towels. No rush.

hero.imageAlt: Interior of Sharp Barber Bangkok with black leather barber chairs, steel workstations and artwork on dark walls

services.title: Pick your chair time
services.intro: Every service includes a consultation, a hot towel finish and a cold drink on the house. Prices in Thai baht.

haircut.name: Signature Haircut
haircut.description: Consultation, precision cut, wash and styling.
haircut.alt: Barber cutting a client’s hair with scissors and a comb above a skin fade

beard.name: Beard Trim & Shape
beard.description: Clipper shaping, sharp line-up and beard oil.
beard.alt: Barber shaping a client’s full beard with a red cordless trimmer

shave.name: Hot Towel Razor Shave
shave.description: Hot towels, rich lather and a straight razor finish.
shave.alt: Client with a moustache reclining while shaving cream is applied before a razor shave

cut-beard.name: Cut & Beard Combo
cut-beard.description: Signature haircut plus beard trim, with a razor-clean neckline.
cut-beard.alt: Barber cleaning up a client’s neckline with a straight razor

royal.name: The Royal Treatment
royal.description: Haircut and full hot towel shave. Our most relaxing hour and a half.
royal.alt: Client under a warm towel receiving a straight razor shave

kids.name: Kids Haircut
kids.description: For ages 12 and under. Patient barbers, no tears.
kids.alt: Barber trimming a young boy’s hair with clippers and a comb

barbers.title: Meet your barbers
barbers.intro: Three chairs, three specialists. Pick your favourite when booking, or let us match you with whoever is free.

krit.name: Krit “Kay” Wongsa
krit.specialty: Textured crops, mullets and modern scissor work
krit.alt: Portrait of barber Krit in a black polo and denim apron, standing next to a barber chair

mateo.name: Mateo Rivera
mateo.specialty: Classic pompadours, beard sculpting and hot towel shaves
mateo.alt: Portrait of barber Mateo with a goatee and tattooed forearms, seated in a leather barber chair

ton.name: Ton Saelim
ton.specialty: Skin fades, tapers and sharp line-ups
ton.alt: Barber Ton in a bucket hat and glasses fading a client’s hair with clippers

booking.title: Book your appointment
booking.intro: No account, no deposit. Walk-ins are welcome too, but booked clients always come first.

steps.title: Send your request
steps.text: Choose a service, barber and time. It takes under a minute.

steps.title: We confirm
steps.text: Our team checks the schedule and confirms by phone or LINE.

steps.title: Take a seat
steps.text: Arrive five minutes early. Pay at the shop, cash or card.

items.name: James T.
items.text: Best skin fade I’ve had in Bangkok, and I’ve tried a lot. Ton took his time, and the hot towel at the end was a nice touch.

items.name: Nattapong S.
items.text: Booked online in a minute and got a confirmation on LINE right away. The Royal Treatment is worth every baht.

items.name: Lukas M.
items.text: Brought my son for his first proper haircut. Kay was patient and made it fun. We’re both regulars now.
